data.name: Aksa
data.gender_notes: Aksa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'aksah' which means 'sanctified' or 'pure'. This name holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam as it evokes feelings of purity, devotion, and holiness. Aksa is a name for a girl whose personality embodies these virtues. The name Aksa carries the meaning “The Sanctified One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aksa usually hope their child will grow to embody the sanctified one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizing a connection to the Divine
data.etymology: Aksa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Sanctified One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aksa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أكسا
in_arabic.meaning: الأبعد أو الأقصى في المسافة أو الدرجة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'أكسا' مشتق من الجذر 'كسا' الذي يعني التغطية أو الارتفاع، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الإسراء: 'ولقد كرمنا بني آدم'، ويشير إلى المكانة العالية أو النهاية القصوى في المسافة أو الدرجة، ويُستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى مكانة رفيعة أو هدف بعيد

in_urdu.name: اکسا
in_urdu.meaning: سب سے دور یا بلند ترین مقام
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'اکسا' عربی جڑ 'کسا' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احاطہ کرنا یا بلند کرنا، اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا تعلق بلند مقام یا انتہائی مسافت سے ہے، اور قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر 'ولقد کرمنا بني آدم' کے طور پر ہوا ہے، جو انسانی نسل کی عزت و تکریم کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अक्सा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'अक्सा' अरबी मूल 'كسا' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है ढकना या ऊंचा करना, इस्लामी परंपरा में यह उच्च स्थान या चरम दूरी को दर्शाता है, और इसका उल्लेख قرآن में 'ولقد کرمنا بني آدم' के रूप में किया गया है, जो मानवता के लिए ईश्वर की विशेष कृपा को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: اکسا
in_pashto.meaning: تر ټولو لرې یا لوړه درجه
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'اکسا' نوم د عربي ريښې 'كسا' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده پوښل یا لوړول، په اسلامي کلتور کې دا لوړ مقام یا اعظمي فاصله ته اشاره کوي، او په قرآن کې د 'ولقد کرمنا بني آدم' په توګه یاد شوی دی، چې د انسان د نسل د عزت او تکريم نښه ده

in_english.name: Aksa
in_english.meaning: The farthest or the highest place
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aksa is derived from the Arabic root 'كسا' (k-s-w), which means to cover or to elevate. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Isra: 'ولقد کرمنا بني آدم', signifying the highest rank or the farthest distance. In Islamic tradition, Aksa symbolizes a lofty status or a distant goal, reflecting spiritual aspirations and human elevation.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic faith attaches great importance to the preservation of personal purity, which is reflected in the term 'Aksa'. In the Islamic context, the term may refer to the Masjid Al-Aqsa, one of the most revered sites in Islam and the third holiest mosque in the world, located in Jerusalem, Palestine. The name shares the religious significance of the site, symbolizing devotion, connection to God, and a commitment to moral purity and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aksa holds a rich spiritual meaning as it evokes feelings of purity, devotion, and holiness. It signifies an individual who practices piety, leads a righteous life and has a deep connection to the Divine. The purity this name represents is both physical and spiritual as it signifies the pursuit of inner peace and the fostering of moral virtues. It is a name that motivates carriers of the name to be ever-mindful and strive to purify their souls and their actions in order to draw closer to their Creator.
